BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Doy & Mari!!
Yay! We found the ark~!
Alright! Let's carry him to Reliza!
That was truly informative, Kunon...\nWhat you just told me was extremely intriguing.\nI learned a lot from it.
You give me too much credit.\nWith my limited abilities, I'm sorry that all I\ncan do is tell you what I saw with my own eyes...
Come on, you always see things from a neutral\nperspective, without letting your feelings get in\nthe way. That's the talent I value most.
Anyway, I'm actually surprised. I could tell\nthat adventurer was no ordinary person, but\nI didn't expect such strength...
Indeed, it's not an exaggeration to say that the\nadventurer saved the world.
Hmm, I'm excited to see that adventurer again!
そろそろ戻る頃合いだろう。この方舟を上昇させる事\nで所在は示したはずだ。
That's true, but we've already been ambushed by\nbandits once...\nWe should avoid taking any unnecessary risks.
On one hand, it's risky, but on the other, we need\nto meet the adventurer as soon as possible.\nIt's a fair trade-off.
Hmm...speak of the devil...
Kunon, allow me to set up a simple bed on the ark!
Oh! Reliza, I'm glad you're here!\nWe need you to prepare some medicine right away~!
Oh, what happened?
Anono collapsed during our journey and still\nhasn't woken up~!
What?! Okay, bring him over here!
His pulse, heartbeat, and energy flow are normal.\nI guess there's nothing to worry about.\nHe probably doesn't need any medicine.
Thank goodness~!\nI was worried that something bad was gonna happen\nto him~!
Well then, I'll get back to nurse him.\nPlease excuse me...
Now that we've run into real trouble, I have to\nsay this.
リグシーの原住民との確たる証拠もない。\n体調が万全とのいうのも自己申告だ。\nアノノを無闇に連れ歩くのは感心しないな
Why are you suddenly acting like his guardian~?
Hmm...you're alright, it seems...
I was actually freaking out~!\nBut of course, thanks to my selfless actions...
My goshhh~~!! F-F-Freedos!! I had no idea that you\nwere really a god, and I was outrageously rude the\nother day!! Please forgive me~~!!!
Right, he's Freedos!\nKunon had a hunch that we'd run into him. So she\nwas right after all!
By the way, Kunon told me everything about you.\nIt seems you've been truly remarkable. As for the\nroyal dragon cocoon, I'll trust you once again...
What the...\nFreedos turns out to be a pretty slick god.
Hey, Zianga!\nWatch your mouth when you talk about Freedos!
As I've said many times, I value harmony.\nI'm simply making a pragmatic decision. After all,\nvanity is the greatest threat to balance.
Then stop talking and just use the royal dragon\ncocoon to grant power to the weredragons' vital\npoint already!
It's a trivial matter...
What?!
The royal dragon's power will eventually spread\nacross Toram. When that happens, the weredragons'\nvital point will naturally be restored.
Do you understand now?
Tch...
This is...?
The royal dragon cocoon?
What's this feeling...I can't look away...
So, you feel it too? Even in its incomplete state,\nthe royal dragon cocoon continues to generate\ninfinite power.
I'm currently devising a way to redirect this\npower to strengthen the ark and keep it running\nwhile resisting Coenubia's control.
Is that possible?
The ark created by Stormia, the Goddess of Wind,\nis still incomplete.
However, I think it will be possible if I use the\npower of the royal dragon cocoon to make up for\nthe missing components.
Wow, that's awesome! The royal dragon cocoon\nreally is something!
Well, I'm still working on my research, though.\nI need your help to continue it.
I'm doing all of this to eradicate Coenubia and\nbring perfect harmony to Toram. Will you lend me\na hand?
Ugh~, I knew this would happen~.
But this time it's a big mission involving the\nroyal dragon cocoon. It kinda bugs me to go along\nwith Freedos's scheme, but I have no objection.
Well then, let's not waste any time.\nYou need to collect...?!
So, you're all here...\nOdious shams who bear the names of gods.
Huh? Anono?
Anono, are you feeling okay now?
Wait, he's not...
I just awakened a moment ago...\nBut I can tell who you are.
Anono...
You are...Anono, aren't you?
Honestly, I admire your tenacity. You've managed\nto keep this transient world intact despite the\nCataclysm that was supposed to end everything.
What?! Anono, what the hey are you talking about?!
My gosh!! Why are there Coenubias here?!
How do I explain this to you?\nDo you understand if I say I was struck by a\nmassive force?
This is annoying...\nThings will be difficult if this is all I can\nmanage through my "fingertip".
Oh, our true king...
Please show us, your foolish followers, the way...
What the...!? They're not attacking Anono!?
And on top of that, they're kneeling before him~!!
This is...
It's a good opportunity...\nLet's find out how strong you really are!
My gosh! They're coming!
Guess we've got no choice. Let's do this!
I know that individual physical strength and the\npower of collective minds are two different\nthings, but still, it's disappointing.
I can't believe that I was once outdone by such a\nfrail species...
Anono? You're Anono, aren't you?
Looks like he's not Anono. He's being possessed by\nsomething!
Anono was possessed by Coenubia when we met him.\nCould it still be hiding inside his body?
Well...\nI am the embodiment of all minds united as one.
Perhaps I should call myself the "gestalt or\nCollective Consciousness of Coenubia".
I just came to know and recognize myself a moment\nago.
The Collective Consciousness of Coenubia...?
Like the commander of Coenubia?
The thoughts of every single Coenubia originate\nfrom my mind...I'm perfectly connected to every\nsingle Coenubia...
If all the mysteries from the abyss are unraveled,\nit's possible. This time for sure, it's been\nproven. With all the power I once almost lost...
Yes, I shall trigger the second Cataclysm...
My gosh?! T-the second C-Catacylsm~?!
You mean you're going to destroy Toram?!
T-there's no way I'll let you do that!
What are you gonna do about it?
Soon our power will be full. It'll flow out from\nthe "Coenubia Pole" where we appeared and engulf\nthe entire world.
Coenubia Pole...
Yeah, it will even reach those so-called gods who\nare still desperately trying to keep Toram intact.
That information will be shared and our power will\ncome together. The world will then crumble, and\nthere'll be no way to stop it.
So, what are you gonna do?\nYou think you can stop it...?
You can have my fingertip back for now.\nThere's something I need to check again.\nIn other words, we'll probably meet again...
Anono, are you okay?!\nHas that thing called the Collective Consciousness\nof Coenubia left your body...?
Aye, now it's just me...I'm Anono...
Anono, you...you remember what happened?
Aye...
Yes, and I remember everything now. The old man in\nGrazen Tower was called Nero Veli. He was a great\nmagus and scientist...
He was doing research on the "Star Chart" with his\nyounger sister, Salvia, as his assistant.
The Lixis were attacked by Coenubia back then, and\nit looks like those in Fango Village were the last\nsurvivors...
The "Star Chart" could wipe out Coenubia, but it\nwasn't ready, so you and your friends had to\nprotect Nero until it was completed, right?
Aye, but...he killed himself before he could\nfinish it.
Apparently my friends and I weren't killed, even\nthough we were defeated. Coenubia must've thought\nthey could make use of our special abilities.
So, the gestalt reached out to that Coenubia and\nfound out about you.
By the way, the Collective Consciousness of\nCoenubia called you "fingertip" or something like\nthat. Why?
Cuz I always wanted to be the first to do stuff.\nI was called the Third Fingertip. Does it mean I'm\nclumsy? Others had names like Eye, Ear, Heel...
It was probably meant to prevent any emotional\nattachment. That Nero guy must have meticulously\nformed an unusual elite squad.
But why the third? What happened to the first and\nsecond?
Some died while training and fighting Coenubia.\nI remember that I was the only one who made it\nuntil the end...Maybe, I'm the last Lixi alive.
I see...
Enough about yourself, now tell us what you know\nabout the gestalt.
Aye...
It made contact with us through you because you\nshare a strong bond with it. But why today, of\nall days?
I dunno. We just connected...\nIt was just formed a moment ago...
It wanted to see you all and tell you, in its own\nwords, about the future world it envisioned...
It spoke of the second Cataclysm.\nYou think it can really make that happen?\nHow much power does it have?
I have no idea.
Where is it now?
I have no clue.
Do you know if it has any weaknesses?
I dunno...
Hmm, so you basically don't have any crucial\ninformation about it...
Bringing minds together is easy. The ability to\ncontrol hearts isn't exclusive to Coenubia either.
The fact that Anono began speaking beyond his\ncontrol doesn't really mean much.
However, the gestalt spoke of the\n"Second Cataclysm". Everyone here should know\nthat's not something we can just ignore.
It would be fine if it were just a bluff.\nBut we can't afford any mistakes.\nToo many lives are in our hands.
We have no choice but to stop it. Let's do our\nbest!
Even I don’t know what to say this time...
This is the moment that will determine Toram's\nfate. We've gotta give it everything we've got!!
From what we know, the gestalt was just formed.\nIt probably knows nothing about those it has yet\nto control. We can take advantage of this...
If we search every corner of the "Coenubia Pole"\nit spoke of, we might be able to find its greatest\nweakness.
To reach that place, as I said earlier, we need to\nbring the ark's design closer to what Stormia\noriginally envisioned.
I'll revise our strategy with this as the main\nfocus. Once everything is ready, I'll have you\ncarry out the plan.
Aye, um, uh, I have something to tell you...
What are you doing, Anono?!\nLook at you, you can't even walk straight yet!!
That's because he was possessed by that mysterious\nCollective Consciousness of Coenubia.\nYou should get some rest.
U-uh...ugh...
Why are you resisting...?
Aye, I dunno, I really dunno...
Though it was by chance, you've been with those\ndenizens from another world and learned from them\nfirsthand. What's going on inside your head now?
U-uh...
Interesting...no matter how hard you try to\nresist, there's a limit. This is not a bond you\ncan break. Come to me, my Third Fingertip...
Aye, guys...
So, is Anono feeling better now?
Well...\nHe seems to be in good health to me.
But I'm somewhat concerned that he's been sleeping\nmore soundly. And even when he wakes up, he just\nstares out the window without saying a word...
Hmm...\nI actually had a few more things I wanted to ask\nthat Lixi.
But, never mind... I'm not gonna push him because\nit'd be troublesome if he collapsed again.\nLet's just do what we must do while we can.
Uh~, by that, do you mean we should prepare to\ndefeat Coenubia~?
Yeah, as I said the other day, the ark was created\nby Stormia, the Goddess of Wind.
If she were on board and controlling the ark,\nreaching the Coenubia Pole would be easy...\nBut unfortunately, she's also gone missing.
Didn't you say we could use the royal dragon\ncocoon's power to make up for the missing\ncomponents?
Yeah, I've been working on it since then, and I\nthink I've found a way to redirect the power to\nthe ark. It should be as good as its final form.
Really?!\nCan we make it to the Coenubia Pole safely!?
For that, we need a few materials.\nI've already gathered some gold and silver, but...
What?! No way?! Gold and Silver?!
Looks like it's still not enough...\nBesides, there are things more important than\ngold or silver that we're still missing.
Freedos and I went over it.\nWe're gonna need several other rare materials.
So, I'm thinking of taking this somewhere else...
What do you mean?
I've surveyed various regions and finally found a\nlandmass with plenty of resources. I plan to move\nthe ark there and move forward with our plan.
The landmass is called Opia Twinpalms.
Though surrounded by steep mountains, the inland\nareas enjoy a mild climate, as if cradled in two\npalms. That's how it got its name.
It's a beautiful name, isn't it?
Yes, it is!
I don't think so...
I knew it would be something special, since\nFreedos found it.\nIt's a beautiful name with so much personality!
You think so?\nIt's too long, I don't like it.
Oh, come on. How could you not like it?\nYou're competent, but it seems you're lacking when\nit comes to appreciating the beauty of words
Anyway, we're not really in a position to say no.\nWe'll just follow along, right?
Good. In that case, let's get ready to set out!
Yes, gladly~!\nI'll help you get ready too, Freedos!!
No, it's not like I want gold or silver as a\nreward~. It's not about that, I swear~!
Looks like Pelulu has been completely tamed.
If Freedos purposely mentioned gold and silver\nbecause he knew what Pelulu is like, he might be a\nreal smart cookie.
